scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run gen && npm run -w apps/api dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run gen && npm run -w apps/web dev
scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run -w packages/shared build && npm run -w apps/api build && npm run -w apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: npm run gen && npm run -w packages/shared typecheck && npm run -w apps/api typecheck && npm run -w apps/web typecheck
